data.narrative: The student used GitHub Copilot Agent to build an understanding of the existing FastAPI workspace and documented its architecture and extension points. They chose task-by-task delegation, independently disproved an incorrect AI claim, and recorded the evidence. The existing test suite is not fully green, so the application is not claimed to be fully verified.

dimension_scores.observation: Provided focused prompts with specific files, constraints, and expected documentation.
dimension_scores.evidence: Asked Copilot to inspect app/, app/models/, tests/, migrations/, requirements.txt, and alembic.ini.

dimension_scores.observation: Independently checked AI claims against actual workspace contents and test results.
dimension_scores.evidence: Ran ls, find, and python -m pytest -q; identified that the platform-only workspace claim was false.

dimension_scores.observation: Used targeted follow-up prompts to correct the inaccurate report, although some setup and CLI troubleshooting required additional attempts.
dimension_scores.evidence: Asked Copilot to add evidence-based BREAK and FIX sections to progress/trust-audit.md.

dimension_scores.observation: Selected task-by-task delegation and avoided accepting unsupported claims or modifying application code unnecessarily.
dimension_scores.evidence: Chose option B and explained that reviewing smaller tasks helps catch incorrect assumptions early.

dimension_scores.observation: Produced useful architecture and trust-audit documentation, but the starter application's tests still have unresolved failures.
dimension_scores.evidence: The test run reported 7 passed and 3 failed; the failures returned 404 where 200, 307, and 410 were expected.

strengths: Used specific, constrained prompts to generate architecture and extension-point documentation.
Verified AI-generated claims using actual files and test output.
Documented the incorrect workspace claim and the evidence-based correction.
growth_areas: Investigate the three failing API tests and establish why the expected demo-link responses are missing before claiming the application is fully verified.
data.recommendation: In Module 02, break the Team Collaboration feature into small tasks with clear file scope, interface expectations, acceptance criteria, and independent tests.
